product_metadata.title: Ameriwood Home Quinton Point 4 shelves Bookcase with Glass Doors, Inspire Cherry
features: Showcase your most prized belongings in the Ameriwood Home Quinton Point Bookcase with Glass Doors
This Bookcase comes complete with 2 framed glass doors on the outside and 4 shelves, including 2 adjustable shelves, for displaying your book collection and memorabilia
Made of laminated MDF, particleboard and tempered glass for a durable build at an affordable price
The decorative handles accentuate the dark oak woodgrain finish for a lovely traditional look
The Bookcase ships flat to your door and 2 adults are recommended to assemble. Each shelf can hold up to 40 lbs. Assembled dimensions: 53.25"H x 29.5625"W x 15.625"D
description: Display your belongings in an elegant way with an Ameriwood Home Quinton Point Bookcase with Glass Doors. With 4 shelves to store your belongings, including 2 that are adjustable, you can rearrange the shelf heights for your needs. This Bookcase features a laminated MDF and particleboard construction along with a brown oak finish, decorative handles and tempered glass doors. That means you can keep your most valued possessions inside without having to worry about dust and other debris. A wall anchor kit is included to secure the Bookcase to the wall and prevent tipping injuries. The Bookcase ships flat to your door and assembly is requires upon opening. Two adults are recommended to assemble. Once assembled, the Bookcase measures to be 53.25"H x 29.5625"W x 15.625"D.
